toolchain.swiftpm_build_system_description: Swift Build was the active default backend in the measured builds; reproduction commands select it explicitly.

active_backend.name: arm64
active_backend.verification: A temporary C++ metadata helper linked each exact CSimdUTF.o, warmed validate_utf8, and queried get_active_implementation(). Both builds selected the same backend.

builds.optimization_verification: C++ response files and cached Swift driver tasks were inspected for both builds. The final C++ optimization flag takes precedence. Swift remains -O in the O3 comparison.
builds.path_placeholders: Private build paths are redacted. Set SCRATCH to a writable build directory; <scratch> denotes its path. Build commands run from Benchmarks/StringAPIs.

benchmark.scope: Released high-level String constructors and temporary contiguous UTF-16/UTF-32 buffer APIs; not isolated allocation-free transcoder throughput.
benchmark.iteration_calibration: Each variant is calibrated independently toward an 8 ms sample, accepting at least half the target during calibration; capped at 1,000,000 iterations.
benchmark.variant_order: Order rotates between samples; the second repeat uses --reverse.
benchmark.execution: Single-threaded, repeated operations on the same prebuilt input for each case.
benchmark.outgoing_string_inputs: Prebuilt native owned Swift Strings. Construction of the input, input-array preparation, and full-content correctness checks occur outside timing.
benchmark.constructor_result_consumption: Every constructed String is materialized as contiguous UTF-8 before the opaque sink, including Foundation-backed constructor results.
benchmark.sink: A separately compiled noinline C function with an opaque memory barrier, without LTO; it neither scans nor retains the buffer.
benchmark.allocation_costs: String result creation and temporary/Array output storage are included in the respective API measurements.
benchmark.correctness: 491 full-content checks outside timing per process, covering package and baseline outputs, malformed UTF-16/UTF-32 replacement, and embedded nulls.
benchmark.throughput_denominator: Input bytes: UTF-16 code-unit count times 2, UTF-32 count times 4, or source String/UTF-8 buffer byte count.
benchmark.utf8_constructor_control: String(decodingUTF8:) forwards to Swift String(decoding:as:); this is a same-decoder control, not a SIMD transcoding claim.
